concerns.text: Step 0.7 ‘Exponential backoff (max 3 retries) for any remote fetch (future‑proof)’ is not linked to any FR or SC in the specification.

Step 2.4 ‘PCA (95 % variance) on training descriptors, fit convex hull, compute Euclidean distance for each novel point’ lacks an explicit FR or SC reference; it should be tied to FR‑005 (evaluation) or an appropriate SC.
Step 3.2 ‘If estimated per‑candidate time > 15 min … skip DFT runs and append note’ is not annotated with FR‑009 or any SC, leaving its traceability to the spec unclear.
